<MethodEndpoint
  method={"delete"}
  path={"/revoked-tokens/{id}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Removes a revoked-token record. This un-revokes the underlying JWT - if it has not
yet expired, it becomes valid again for authentication. Administrators only.
